qualifier: skin, melanocyte pigmentation and intestinal epithelium
name: Skin, pigment cell and intestinal epithelial differentiation
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte/epidermal and skin-appendage development, MITF-M-driven melanocyte pigmentation and intestinal/hepatic epithelial identity programmes, which separates the theme from confusables centred on eye/ear, tooth and pancreatic development.

core: Vascular tone and blood pressure regulation
name: Endothelial nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
rationale: All members concern eNOS activation, NO/cGMP signaling and its effects on vascular smooth muscle contraction and arterial pressure, unlike confusables built on renin-angiotensin control or generic smooth muscle contraction.

qualifier: strand invasion and recombination intermediate resolution
name: Recombinational DNA repair via strand invasion and intermediate resolution
rationale: Members describe strand invasion, break-induced replication, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, cross-link repair and resolution of recombination intermediates, distinct from confusables about replication initiation, NHEJ/BRCA damage sensing and telomere maintenance.

name: Nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members share plasma-membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside transport, nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and metabolism of nucleoside-analogue drugs (abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine/TPMT), whereas confusables cover de novo purine synthesis, salvage and pyrimidine catabolism.

name: Action potential regulation including sinoatrial pacemaking
rationale: All members regulate action potential generation or propagation, and the SA-node and HCN members distinguish the theme from confusables about resting membrane potential and two-pore K+ channels.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase and coenzyme A synthesis
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase and coenzyme A biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA and pantothenate-to-CoA synthesis, distinct from TCA/malate shuttle, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and NAD metabolism confusables.

name: Forebrain neural progenitor division and stem cell maintenance
rationale: All members concern division and maintenance of forebrain neuroblasts/neural stem cells, unlike confusables about spindle orientation, cortical migration, forebrain patterning or glial fate.

name: Residue hydroxylation, oxidation, diphthamide and selenocysteine formation
rationale: Members are unusual residue modifications (lysine/proline hydroxylation, formylglycine oxidation in arylsulfatases, diphthamide on EEF2, selenocysteine insertion), separating them from hypusine/wybutosine, methylation and tRNA aminoacylation confusables.

name: Ceramide and sphingomyelin metabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo sphingolipid synthesis, ceramide production and sphingomyelin synthesis/breakdown, whereas confusables concern glycerophospholipid synthesis and remodeling.

qualifier: early stages from intermediate mesoderm to S-shaped body
name: Early nephrogenesis from intermediate mesoderm to S-shaped body
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, metanephric mesenchyme-to-epithelium transition, renal vesicle and comma/S-shaped body stages, unlike confusables on ureter, distal segments or kidney size control.

name: Ganglioside and glycosphingolipid catabolism
rationale: All members describe lysosomal breakdown of gangliosides/glycosphingolipids including HEXA/HEXB deficiencies, distinct from sialic acid, oligosaccharide and GAG degradation confusables.

qualifier: appetite, somatic growth and stress axis
name: Neuroendocrine control of appetite, somatic growth and stress
rationale: Members combine leptin/ghrelin feeding control, GH/prolactin/IGF growth signaling and HPA glucocorticoid stress responses, which distinguishes them from GI peptide GPCR, beta-cell and neuropeptide-behaviour confusables.

name: Exocyst vesicle tethering in GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members share exocyst-dependent vesicle tethering and RHOQ-driven protein targeting to the plasma membrane as in GLUT4 translocation, whereas confusables concern insulin signaling and glucose import more broadly.
The three members (mitochondrial depolarization, osmotic-stress apoptosis inhibition, nucleotide biosynthesis inhibition) share no single nameable biological process.

name: Retinol and retinal metabolism and cellular uptake
rationale: Members concern retinol/retinal (diterpenoid) metabolism and transport including STRA6 defects, unlike confusables centred on retinoic acid synthesis or the visual retinoid cycle.

name: Chondroitin and dermatan sulfate biosynthesis and linkage region
rationale: All members cover chondroitin/dermatan sulfate chain and linkage tetrasaccharide synthesis and their connective-tissue disorders, distinct from keratan and heparan sulfate or O-fucose/glucose glycosylation confusables.

qualifier: melanosome, dense granule and synaptic vesicle cargo loading
name: Lysosome-related organelle biogenesis and vesicle cargo loading
rationale: Members describe assembly and cargo loading of melanosomes, platelet dense granules and synaptic vesicles, unlike confusables on Golgi-lysosome trafficking, clathrin coat dynamics or melanin synthesis.

name: Regulation of antimicrobial peptide production and microbial killing
rationale: Members regulate antimicrobial peptide synthesis and antibacterial/antifungal humoral killing, while confusables list specific defensins, mucosal innate responses and bacterial interaction processes.

name: Lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoids and specialized pro-resolving mediators
rationale: Members cover lipoxygenase and epoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, hepoxilins, EETs) plus resolvins, protectins and maresins, which confusables on omega-hydroxylase HETEs and eicosanoid receptors lack.

name: Neuropeptide signaling in sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide (orexin/NPFF/QRFP) G-protein signaling with REM, non-REM and wakefulness regulation, distinct from confusables on social, feeding and opioid behaviours.

name: HIV Nef downregulation of host immune surface receptors
rationale: All members are Nef-mediated removal of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC class I from the cell surface, unlike confusables on antigen presentation or HIV replication.

qualifier: beta-cell secretion control and GLUT4 glucose uptake
name: Beta-cell insulin secretion and insulin-stimulated glucose uptake
rationale: Members cover K-ATP, incretin and neurotransmitter control of beta-cell insulin secretion plus insulin receptor signaling and GLUT4-mediated uptake, distinct from glucagon/gluconeogenesis, fatty acid oxidation and muscle confusables.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan, glycolipid and sialoglycan catabolism
rationale: Members describe lysosomal degradation of GAGs (mucopolysaccharidoses), gangliosides, oligosaccharides and sialic acid/amino sugar metabolism, whereas confusables concern glycan and GAG biosynthesis.

qualifier: G1/S via RB1-E2F, CDK inhibitors and p53 stability
name: G1/S checkpoint control via RB1-E2F and p53 stability
rationale: Members concern cyclin D/CDK4/6 and cyclin E/CDK2 control, RB1-E2F, p21/p27 and Cdc25A degradation and p53 phosphorylation/turnover, unlike confusables centred on G2/M checkpoints and broad E2F/APC-C cell-cycle machinery.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta handling in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members regulate microglial/astrocyte activation, amyloid-beta formation and clearance, tau tangles and lysosomal function, distinct from confusables on glial proliferation, axon regeneration or amyloid fibril biochemistry.
